title: OpenWiki: a CLI that generates your repo wiki and keeps it current via daily GitHub Action PR

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Agent docs usually rot because code changes faster than anyone updates the wiki. Open wiki is a CLI that writes that documentation once then keeps it current. Point it at your repo and it generates a wiki. Then a daily GitHub action opens a PR to refresh it as the code changes. It drops prompting into your agents.mmd or claw.md automatically so your agent knows to check it
